coverage_rationale: The article focuses on the appointment of Shelley Reynolds as the General Manager for South Australia, which is a significant internal development for Gallagher Bassett.

gb_statements.speaker: Shelley Reynolds
gb_statements.text: I’m honoured to take on the permanent role of General Manager for South Australia and continue leading our talented team in supporting employers, injured workers and the broader South Australian community

gb_statements.speaker: Shelley Reynolds
gb_statements.text: I’m passionate about customer experience. We have an experienced team that understands South Australia’s unique environment, and is committed to understanding customer feedback and embedding insights into our operational decision-making.

gb_statements.speaker: Shelley Reynolds
gb_statements.text: Reynolds has identified customer experience, digital transformation and the use of client feedback in operational decision-making among her priorities in the permanent role.

key_messages.message: Shelley Reynolds has been appointed as the permanent General Manager for Gallagher Bassett's South Australian operations.
key_messages.supporting_excerpt: Gallagher Bassett has appointed Shelley Reynolds (pictured) as general manager for South Australia, putting permanent leadership in place at one of the state’s two claims-agent operations as the company continues to develop and expand claims practices first used in the state.

key_messages.message: Reynolds prioritizes customer experience, digital transformation, and the use of client feedback in her new role.
key_messages.supporting_excerpt: Reynolds has identified customer experience, digital transformation and the use of client feedback in operational decision-making among her priorities in the permanent role.

key_messages.message: Gallagher Bassett's South Australian operation serves as a model for claims-management practices being expanded interstate.
key_messages.supporting_excerpt: The South Australian operation has also served as a base for claims-management practices that Gallagher Bassett has since taken interstate.
